Initial release of AI Animation Generator Free — create animations from simple text prompts or images.

- Instantly generate 1080p MP4 animation clips from your descriptions, no drawing or complex tools required.
- Supports uploading text, images (PNG, JPG), and videos (MP4, MOV) up to 200MB.
- Free access: automatically handles authentication and anonymous tokens for up to 100 free credits.
- Includes seamless workflows: upload, edit, preview, and export finished videos in minutes.
- Works entirely in the cloud — no software installation or GPU needed.
- Robust error handling, support for multiple formats, and live session management.
